homeCms.heroTitle: Discover Your Child's Hidden Natural Talents Early
homeCms.heroSubtitle: Every child is born with unique cognitive, creative, and athletic gifts. Our play-based scientific skill mapping helps parents identify natural strengths between ages 3 to 10 years.
homeCms.trustedParentsText: Trusted by 25,000+ Indian Parents for early talent mapping.

whyChooseUsCms.title: The Smartest Choice for Your Child's Future
whyChooseUsCms.subtitle: We combine science, technology, and care to deliver the most accurate and actionable talent discovery experience for your child.

cards.title: Scientifically Backed Assessments
cards.desc: Our assessments are designed by child psychologists and education experts using globally recognized frameworks like Howard Gardner's Multiple Intelligences theory.

cards.title: Trusted by 10,000+ Families
cards.desc: Thousands of parents across India trust our platform to discover and nurture their children's hidden talents, with a 98% satisfaction rate.

cards.title: Personalized Learning Plans
cards.desc: Every child receives a tailored development roadmap with specific activity recommendations, book lists, and hobby suggestions based on their unique profile.

cards.title: Track Growth Over Time
cards.desc: Monitor your child's progress with detailed reports and milestone tracking. See how their skills evolve and celebrate every achievement along the way.

cards.title: 100% Safe & Private
cards.desc: Your child's data is encrypted and completely confidential. We never share personal information with third parties. Your privacy is our top priority.

cards.title: Quick & Easy Process
cards.desc: Complete the assessment in just 15-20 minutes from the comfort of your home. Get instant, detailed results with actionable insights — no waiting required.

ourAdvantagesCms.title: The Key Advantages of Early Talent Mapping
ourAdvantagesCms.subtitle: We combine cognitive science, AI, and structured play to give your child an unfair advantage in early childhood development.

cards.title: 90% Synaptic Growth Window
cards.desc: Synaptic brain connections peak between ages 3 and 7. Identifying natural inclinations during this critical period ensures effortless learning.

cards.title: Avoid Mismatched Tuitions
cards.desc: Save time and money by avoiding trial-and-error classes. Focus only on activities aligned with your child's natural cognitive strengths.

cards.title: Nurture Innate Talents
cards.desc: Whether logic, visual arts, or verbal fluency, early discovery lets natural talents flourish with intrinsic joy rather than external pressure.

cards.title: Unshakable Self-Confidence
cards.desc: Children excel when engaged in tasks matching their profile. Early success builds intrinsic motivation and lifelong self-esteem.

cards.title: Prevent Academic Burnout
cards.desc: When learning style aligns with cognitive strength, studying becomes an exciting adventure rather than a stressful homework chore.

cards.title: Actionable Parent Roadmap
cards.desc: Get tailored recommendations for books, educational toys, sports, and hobbies tailored specifically to your child's unique profile.

ourMethodologyCms.title: The Science of Child Talent Profiling
ourMethodologyCms.subtitle: Our play-based methodology is built upon Howard Gardner's Multiple Intelligences framework, Montessori observational standards, and pediatric cognitive psychology.
ourMethodologyCms.bannerTitle: No Exams. No Pressure. Pure Playful Discovery. 🎈
ourMethodologyCms.bannerDesc: Traditional schooling evaluates children using rigid exam benchmarks. Our system observes children during natural home play — analyzing how they solve spatial puzzles, express emotions, build Lego structures, and respond to music.

programsCms.title: Tailored Programs for Every Milestone
programsCms.subtitle: Children develop distinct cognitive and physical capabilities at different ages. Our programs match your child's exact developmental stage.

assessmentProcessCms.title: How Child Talent Discovery Works
assessmentProcessCms.subtitle: Simple, non-stressful, and parent-guided. Discover your child's innate strengths in 5 simple steps.
assessmentProcessCms.ctaTitle: Ready to Discover Your Child's Core Potential?
assessmentProcessCms.ctaSubtitle: Takes less than 20 minutes of guided observational play. Get your 12-page Talent Profile immediately.

steps.title: Register Your Child
steps.desc: Create a free parent profile and enter basic information about your child
steps.details: Quick 2-minute registration without complex paperwork. Completely private and secure.

steps.title: Choose Age Group
steps.desc: Select the age-tailored evaluation module (3–5 Yrs, 5–7 Yrs, or 7–10 Yrs) matching your child's developmental milestone.
steps.details: Each age bucket features scientifically calibrated games, observational scenarios, and task prompts.

steps.title: Complete Skill Assessment
steps.desc: Engage in fun, play-based interactive tasks and observational activities alongside your child at home.
steps.details: No stressful exams! Activities feel like enjoyable puzzles, creative drawing, or rhythm games.

steps.title: Receive Talent Report
steps.desc: Get an instant, comprehensive 12-page Talent Profile breaking down cognitive, creative, and social strengths.
steps.details: Includes visual radar charts, benchmark percentiles, and identified hidden natural talents.

steps.title: Get Personalized Recommendations
steps.desc: Unlock a customized 3-year learning pathway, recommended hobbies, books, and talent nurturing activities.
steps.details: Direct advice on what activities to encourage and how to avoid early academic burnout.

assessmentProcessCms.pageHeroSubtitle: A step-by-step walkthrough of registration, play-based task activities, instant report generation, and personalized learning guidance.
